entities.summary: Murad Allahverdiyev is an Azerbaijani boxer. He competed at the 2023 European Games, winning the bronze medal in the men's light heavyweight event. He also competed at the 2024 Summer Olympics in the men's 80 kg event, but was defeated in the quarter-final by Nurbek Oralbay.
